description: List all browsers connected to Browser Bridge. Call this first before any other tool; use set_browser when multiple browsers are online.
name: list_browsers

description: Explicitly choose which connected browser to control for this MCP session. Requires a browserId obtained from list_browsers.
name: set_browser

description: Navigate a specific tab of the selected browser to a URL. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: navigate

description: Go back one page in the browser history. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: go_back

description: Go forward one page in the browser history. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: go_forward

description: Refresh the current page. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: refresh

description: List all tabs in the selected browser.
name: tab_list

description: Open a new tab in the selected browser. Defaults to opening in the background (active=false).
name: tab_new

description: Close a tab in the selected browser by tab ID. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: tab_close

description: Switch to a tab by its ID in the selected browser. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: tab_switch

description: Click an element in the selected browser by CSS selector. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: click

description: Type text into an input element in the selected browser. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: type

description: Select an option from a dropdown in the selected browser by CSS selector. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: select

description: Scroll the page or an element in the selected browser. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: scroll

description: Hover over an element in the selected browser by CSS selector. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: hover

description: Get the text content of an element by CSS selector. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: get_text

description: Get the raw innerHTML of an element by CSS selector. Escape hatch for untouched markup — prefer the snapshot tool for reading and understanding page content. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: get_html

description: Take a compact, budgeted snapshot of the page: interactive elements (links, buttons, text boxes, checkboxes, combos) and headings, with stable @eN refs you can pass to other tools as selectors (e.g. "@e12"). Use this to see what you can ACT ON. Default filter is "interactive"; pass filter="full" for the complete pseudo-tree including text runs, images and structural containers. To READ page content (article body, email subjects, feed items), use get_text instead — it returns plain text and is the right tool for reading. When output is truncated, text runs may be replaced by placeholders (full filter) or dropped (interactive filter); narrow with selector or raise max_chars. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: snapshot

description: Take a screenshot of the selected browser. For getting html or text content, use the get_html or get_text tools first. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: screenshot

description: Get title, URL, and active status of a specific tab. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: pageinfo

description: Wait for an element to appear in the selected browser by CSS selector. The selector must exist on the page — if you have not seen the DOM yet, call snapshot first and use a rendered selector or its @eN ref. A semantic guess like "article" only matches real <article> tags. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: wait_element

description: Wait for navigation to complete in the selected browser. Requires a valid tab_id — call tab_list first to discover open tabs.
name: wait_navigation
